population: All severity-eligible candidate collisions in selected official NCDB 1999–2021 annual releases; no feature-completeness exclusion; conditional on recorded fatal/injury collision.
positive_meaning: collision producing at least one fatality
split_policy: Disjoint chronological whole-collision partitions; every eligible collision included exactly once. C_YEAR is grouping only. No shuffle, refit on train+validation, or test-driven model/threshold changes.
test_status: Years 2020–2021 were already inspected descriptively in EDA. This is a fixed retrospective temporal holdout, not a pristine prospective test.

encoding.method: dictionary-fixed one-hot encoding; drop exactly the declared reference per feature; sparse float64 matrix
encoding.out_of_domain: Reject the run before fitting or scoring, including null, blank, conflicting or undocumented codes; preserve immutable prepared inputs for investigation.
encoding.sentinels: Preserve dictionary-supported unknown U/UU, other Q/QQ and unavailable X/XX as distinct levels; no imputation, pooling or complete-case deletion.
encoding.train_unobserved: Keep supported dictionary column; training-zero columns have neutral zero coefficient and are flagged in coefficient and score-support evidence. Report test/validation occurrence separately; a neutral coefficient is lack of training evidence, not demonstrated absence of association.

prevalence_baseline.probability: Training fatal count divided by training collision count; constant across every evaluated partition. No validation/test prevalence fitting.

fitting_policy: Fit baseline prevalence and logistic coefficients once using training labels only. Dictionary domains/references are fixed external metadata. Validation labels select only the illustrative threshold. Never fit transforms, coefficients, calibration or model selection to test labels.

metrics.probability_scores: Natural-log binary log loss with float64 epsilon clipping; Brier mean((y-p)^2). Lower is better.
metrics.ranking_definitions: Average precision uses recall-step weighting of precision (not trapezoidal PR area); ROC-AUC uses probability ranking. Higher is better. Undefined one-class ranking metrics explicitly null.
metrics.classification_definitions: Predict fatal when probability >= threshold. Precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero denominator reported as zero with count denominators available.
metrics.accuracy_policy: Accuracy is not a primary comparison or acceptance criterion because fatalities are rare.

validation_selected.candidate_thresholds: Distinct logistic prediction probabilities in validation; probability >= threshold.
validation_selected.rule: Among thresholds with validation recall >= 0.80, maximize validation precision; ties choose higher threshold. If no valid threshold, fail threshold-selection check.
validation_selected.application: Freeze the resulting numerical threshold before test scoring; apply the same threshold to logistic and prevalence baseline on all partitions/years/groups.
validation_selected.interpretation: Illustrative recall operating point, not an operational recommendation or a decision-cost optimum.

calibration.ece: sum over nonempty bins of (bin_count/partition_count)*abs(observed_fatal_proportion-mean_predicted_probability); bins are fixed, ECE is descriptive and bin-dependent.
calibration.empty_bins: Retain count zero; averages undefined/null. No fitted calibration correction.

late_period_checks: Year-specific prevalence, probability/ranking/threshold metrics and calibration
Feature distributions and sentinel shares vs train and validation
Feature/category subgroup probability error and recall/precision, with denominators
reporting.subgroups: Each allowed categorical feature separately, retaining unknown/other/unavailable. No exhaustive interaction search.

sparse_rule.action: Flag, retain and avoid stable-ranking claims; show denominator and fatal count. Zero-support dictionary levels recorded as absent.

reporting.missingness: Report unknown U/UU, unavailable X/XX, other Q/QQ separately by split/year; do not label other as missing. Score all valid supported categories.
figures: precision–recall comparison for validation and test with prevalence reference
fixed-bin reliability comparison for validation and test
annual prevalence and model probability-error diagnostics
reporting.coefficients: Export level, reference, training count, coefficient, exp(coefficient) and training-unobserved flag. L2-regularized conditional associations; no standard-error, significance or causal claims.

implementation_required: Upstream fingerprints current and receipts passed
No duplicate candidate keys or overlapping/lost split rows
Binary target and exact eight-feature allowlist
Only supported dictionary categories; reference levels correct
All fitted quantities training-only except explicitly validation-selected threshold
Logistic convergence warning absent and iterations below cap
Finite [0,1] scores and independently reconciled confusion/calibration/count metrics
acceptance.predictive_assessment: Report test log-loss and Brier differences (logistic minus prevalence baseline), pooled and by 2020/2021. Improvement means negative difference; do not force success, tune on test, or claim usefulness solely from ranking. A failed improvement is an informative modeling result, not permission to change this frozen run.

limitations: No exposure/non-crash denominator: no collision-occurrence probabilities
No geographic fields for local hotspots
Conditions are post-crash recorded; prospective feature availability unverified
Source/release composition and reporting changes cannot be isolated from real-world case-mix shifts
2020–2021 already inspected in EDA; no pristine prospective test
No deployment readiness or causal policy-effect claim
No probabilistic uncertainty interval promised for model metrics or penalized coefficients in this baseline phase
amendment_policy: Any post-freeze change requires a separately versioned protocol documenting reason/timing; retain this frozen file/hash and disclose whether test outputs were seen. Do not overwrite this protocol after fit.
